row.notes: Chained hash-map find. Hash = boost-style combine of the entrant identity (key+0x50 id, or for flag 0x10000000 the xor of the online user-id words at +0x18/+0x20 or +0x28/+0x30 depending on type byte +0x10) with the packed u16 from +0x58/+0x5a, masked by map+0x40; walks the bucket list (buckets +0x28) comparing identity (Ne_UserId_Equals fallback), +0x5a short and +0x58 byte. Writes the node or the end sentinel map+0x10 to *out_iter.
